# Sprint 2 — Vé sự kiện
Vietnamese internal UI demo, fictional events only. Ticketbox reference observed 04/10/2026: emerald navigation header, dark neutral discovery canvas, poster-led information and prominent date/price. Borrow content hierarchy and event browsing clarity, not brand/logo/artwork.
Organizer area uses Quiet Operations from project docs: #F7F8FA canvas, white surfaces, #172033 text, #667085 metadata, #D6DAE1 border, #175CD3 primary, #1849A9 hover. No marketing hero in operations. Geist 24/32 page titles, 14/21 body, 12/18 metadata. 32px desktop/16px mobile gutters. Inputs/buttons radius 6, panels 8, dialogs 12; no decorative gradients/glass/neon/heavy shadows. Single primary per task, table/dividers rather than nested cards. Public discovery may use charcoal #202124 backgrounds behind fictional poster artwork; controls keep primary blue identity.
Seat glyphs square with symbols: available hollow, held by you blue + check, held by others neutral + lock/hatch, sold dark + X. Prices in Vietnamese 1.250.000 ₫, no color-only distinction. Category label and price visible.
All screens responsive, 44px touch targets, readable labels, visible focus. Desktop seat map + 340px summary, mobile map + bottom summary. Server confirms holding; expiry is 10 minutes from first seat, extra seats do not reset. All-or-none conflict, list rejected seats. No payment/order/QR/check-in/register/restore-session/release-seat feature in Sprint2. Controls to later sprint may be visibly disabled and labeled unavailable in this demo.
Create designed UI screens, no source code changes. Mark discreetly Demo Sprint 2 · dữ liệu giả. Same fictional event Đêm nhạc Tháng Mười, 16/10/2026 19:30, Nhà hát Ánh Dương (địa điểm giả); VIP 1.200.000 ₫, Tiêu chuẩn 650.000 ₫, Ban công 350.000 ₫ across all screens.
